title: Characterizing the Noise-Lag Tradeoff of Inertia Estimation: A Methodology Applied to Virtual Synchronous Generators
description: 1st author. Submitted to 14th Annual IEEE Conference on Technologies for Sustainability. The decrease in power system inertia (and thus stability) caused by the increased penetration of inverter-based resources (i.e. renewable energy) necessitates better methods of inertia estimation. Inertia estimation usually requires the use of the rate of change of frequency (RoCoF) measurements, including non-negligible noise. A low-pass filter can provide noise attenuation, but a higher filter time constant causes delay and possible signal distortions. We establish a framework for characterizing this tradeoff and test on existing methods. By quantifying estimation error and variability across filtering parameters, the proposed framework identifies configurations that favor accuracy versus consistency. The results demonstrate that these objectives can favor different filtering settings, providing practical guidance for evaluating and configuring virtual inertia estimators in inverter-based power systems.

title: Wavelet-Based Multiscale Anisotropy-Aware Cell-Cell Communication Inference and Niche Segmentation (2026)
description: 2nd author; team project. Presented in the 9th International Conference on Computational Biology and Bioinformatics (2025). Cell–cell communication (CCC) analysis in spatial transcriptomics (ST) should reflect how tissue architecture channels or blocks signaling, yet most methods assume isotropic diffusion and ignore directional constraints from tumor–stroma interfaces, aligned collagen, and anisotropic extracellular space. We introduce Wavelet-Based Multiscale Anisotropy-Aware Cell-Cell Communication Inference and Niche Segmentation (WACCCN), the first anisotropic CCC inference model, which uses wavelet-derived orientation features from histology and gene expression to build anisotropic, morphology-gated kernels for CCC and integrates these with a multi-view autoencoder for niche segmentation.
